Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.views

Class RunViewPage

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.views.RunViewPage
public final class RunViewPage extends Object
One page of a run-view event stream: the envelope the events endpoint returns and the client polls.

The wire form is {contractVersion, events, next, more, terminal}. A page with no events still carries next.
